Download **AutobahnRush.apk** below, open it on your Android phone and allow installing apps from this source when asked.

- Villages along the Landstraße: Ortstafel, 50 limit, plastered and half-timbered houses, a church with an onion dome, street lamps, hedges and a side street
- Even more roads: up to three side roads at once on the right of the Landstraße, plus the left side
- Keep going after a crash or arrest by watching one ad; an ad between runs every 3rd try (Google AdMob test ads in this build)
- Consent form where required, and Settings → Datenschutz & Werbung

If no release key is configured yet (see docs/ANDROID.md), the APK is debug-signed and an update may need the old version uninstalled first.
